race.comment: THE TORQUE FACTOR (9) earns top billing with three straight wins, the latest a determined BM65 success at Gold Coast over 1800m after also winning comfortably in a BM62 at Ipswich. The rise in grade is the obvious hurdle, but his 1650m record is strong and Yvette Lewis is unbeaten in three rides on him. AWAYGOESTHEBUNNY (5) looks the immediate threat, having run second as favourite in a BM85 at Doomben after winning an Open at Gold Coast. Only has to hold his form to be very competitive. SHINY NEW DEEL (8) was good in his stable debut at the Gold Coast when flashing home into fifth after settling a long way back. Will likely drift back again from the draw and be saved for the final shot at them. GLOBAL ECLIPSE (3) bounced back to win a CL3 at the Sunny Coast as favourite and his overall record at this distance gives him a genuine chance to carry that form into stronger company.
